The '''Pius Dea Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Great Peace of the Republic|reign]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] possessed horizontal landing fields, was positioned near the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and was to the far north of the large industrial area known as [[The Works/Legends|The Works]].<ref name="Plagueis" /> The Pius Dea Spaceport shared its name with the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] religious cult known as the [[Pius Dea]], who controlled the Galactic Republic from [[11,987 BBY]] to around [[10,966 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> While in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] traveling into The Works on one occasion between [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]] and [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], [[Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was reminded of the Pius Dea Spaceport.<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pius Dea Spaceport was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Plagueis" />
